summary: Commit historical snapshot anchors with each indexed block and gate readiness on complete history
details: Reuse the exact upstream block commit to persist the historical anchor in the same SQLite block transaction as business state, coverage, and synced height, eliminating normal post-scan history RPC backfill.
Read published heights and coverage through a separate committed SQLite view so open writer savepoints cannot expose uncommitted progress.

Reconcile continuous anchor coverage before RPC startup, repair legacy holes in bounded atomic batches, and keep HistoryBackfillPending across failures and restarts until the committed range is covered.
Expose snapshot_history_ready_height and snapshot_history_pending_from, validate recovered anchors against local upstream commits, and rewind coverage during reorg rollback.
Cover stationary upstreams, failed writes, interrupted processes before and after commit, partial backfill recovery, invalid anchors, and rollback/replay.
operator_actions: Ship the updated usdb-services image and restart the indexer to adopt this fix. Existing databases are retained and any historical anchor holes are repaired before consensus readiness.
Observe the new history coverage fields and HistoryBackfillPending while legacy data is repaired; do not bypass the controller readiness gate.
